# Interface How-To — Construction phase

<!-- GENERATED by src/tests/exploration/gen-howto.ts — do not edit by hand.
     Requests derive from the tested exploration bindings; responses + MCP
     schemas from .out/howto-capture.json; option tables from @Option /
     inputSchema / @ApiProperty. exploration.spec.ts fails CI on drift. -->

Build the system against the design: scaffold the workspace, generate domain code, then validate and gate what you built. Every operation is stateless — the Core evaluates the context you send and returns a verdict.

**Envelope:** every response is an ADR-0073 envelope `{ success, data | error: { code, message }, meta }`.
**Exit codes (CLI):** `0` on a passing verdict, non-zero on a failing verdict or error.
**Mutative MCP tools** require `{ "apply": true, "approvalToken": "…" }` (the dispatch gates them; `RULESET_NOT_FOUND` etc. are consistent across surfaces).
**Reading the response blocks:** they are the SHAPE of what the interface really returned, not a sample of data. Every field name is real and every value carries its type — `"<string>"`, `"<number>"` — because what a rule counts or a gate decides depends on the workspace being evaluated, not on the interface. An array is shown as a single element merging every element observed. Values that ARE the contract are printed literally: `success`, `command`/`tool`, the error `code`, and `schemaVersion`.

Operations in this phase: `scaffold-architecture`, `sdlc-generate`, `validate-satellite`, `composable-validate`, `detect-drift`, `evaluate`, `gate-evaluate`, `phase-artifacts-evaluate`.

### Generate code from DDD models

> `sdlc-generate` — Generate hexagonal architecture scaffold from Mermaid classDiagram in DDD model file

#### CLI
Command: `evolith-cli sdlc generate`

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f, --from <path>` | Path to the Markdown DDD model file containing a Mermaid classDiagram |
| `-o, --output <dir>` | Target directory for generated files (default: current working directory) |
| `--dry-run` | Print what would be generated without writing any files |
| `-f, --format <string>` | Output format: json (ADR-0073 envelope) or human (default) |

Example:
```bash
evolith-cli sdlc generate domain --from package.json --format json
```
Response shape (captured live):
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INTERNAL_ERROR",
    "message": "<string>"
  },
  "meta": {
    "command": "GenerateDomainCommand",
    "correlationId": "<string>",
    "durationMs": "<number>",
    "executedAt": "<string>",
    "schemaVersion": "1.0.0"
  },
  "success": false
}
```

Tool: `evolith-sdlc-generate`

> ⚠ Exposed on MCP but not yet in the conformance bindings — no worked example derived.

### Validate satellite compliance

> `validate-satellite` — Validate a satellite repository against Evolith governance standards

#### CLI
Command: `evolith-cli validate`

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f, --format [string]` | Output format (json, table, yaml, markdown) |
| `-o, --output [string]` | Path to write the JSON report to |
| `-s, --satellite [path]` | Path to the satellite repository (default: cwd) |
| `-c, --core [path]` | Path to the Evolith Core repository (default: auto-detect) |
| `--select <ref>` | Evaluate ONLY the named ruleset(s), by the ref `evolith rulesets`  |
| `-r, --ruleset [id]` | Validate a specific ruleset (adr-0002, acl, open-core, inheritance, cli-release, cli-parity, evidence, mcp, observability) |
| `-a, --arch` | Validate architecture across the whole progressive axis (equivalent to the three progressive topologies) |
| `-t, --topology [id]` | Canonical topology to validate (repeatable): modular-monolith, distributed-modules,  |
| `-e, --engine [engine]` | Validation engine to use: native (default) or opa |
| `--max-skipped-fraction <fraction>` | Coverage floor: fail if the fraction of applicable rules NOT evaluated exceeds this value (0..1).  |
| `-m, --manifest [path]` | Path to the SatelliteManifest JSON for end-to-end evaluation (enables the GT-281 pipeline) |
| `-p, --phase [phase]` | Fase SDLC a evaluar: discovery, design, construction, qa, release. Activa pipeline GT-281 |
| `--adr [id]` | Validate against specific ADR rules (adr-0002, adr-0005, adr-0010, adr-0018, adr-0032, adr-0040, adr-0050) |
| `--file [path]` | Validate a single file (ad-hoc mode) |
| `--composable` | Use the composable validation engine (GT-312) with smart mode resolution |

Example:
```bash
evolith-cli validate --satellite /abs/path/to/your-satellite --core /abs/path/to/evolith-core --format json
```

### Architecture drift detection

> `detect-drift` — Detect architecture drift between declared level and actual codebase

#### CLI
Command: `evolith-cli drift`

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-p, --path [path]` | Project path to analyze (default: current directory) |
| `-l, --level [level]` | Declared progressive-axis topology: modular-monolith, distributed-modules, microservices |
| `--json` | Output report as JSON |
| `--history` | Show drift history |
| `--trend` | Show drift trend analysis |
| `-f, --format [string]` | Output format: json (ADR-0073 envelope) or human (default) |

Example:
```bash
evolith-cli drift --path /abs/path/to/your-satellite --format json
```

### Evaluate EvaluationContext

> `evaluate` — Evaluate an EvaluationContext (gates, artifacts, rules, compliance) and return an EvaluationResult (ADR-0101 stateless Core entry point)

#### CLI
Command: `evolith-cli evaluate`

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--context [path]` | Path to a JSON file with a canonical EvaluationContext |
| `-w, --workspace [path]` | Local workspace path (interpreted as workspaceRef; default: profile/cwd) |
| `-c, --core [path]` | Path to the Evolith Core repository (default: auto-detect) |
| `-p, --phase [id]` | Canonical SDLC phase id (discovery|design|construction|qa|release) |
| `-t, --topology [id]` | Confirmed topology (repeatable: -t modular-monolith -t agentic-ai) |
| `-f, --format [string]` | Output format (json | text | sarif | drift). Default: json |
| `--evidence [path]` | Write the enforcer-evidence manifest (EVD-01..03) to a file (GT-518) |
| `--waivers [path]` | Waiver store path (default: <workspace>/.evolith/waivers.json). Approved, unexpired, fingerprint-matching waivers suppress findings (GT-677) |

Example:
```bash
evolith-cli evaluate --workspace /abs/path/to/your-satellite --core /abs/path/to/evolith-core --format json
```

#### MCP
Tool: `evolith-evaluate`

| Argument | Type | Req. | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kinds` | array |  | Evaluation kinds (e.g. ['gate','compliance']) |

| `corePath` | string |  | Optional explicit path to the Evolith Core repository |
| `waiverStore` | string |  | Optional waiver store path (default: <workspaceRef>/.evolith/waivers.json). Read-only: this tool honours approved waivers, it cannot create or approve them (GT-677). |

| `product` | object |  | Opaque product context { productId } |
| `initiative` | object |  | Opaque initiative context { initiativeId } |

| `topologyRef` | string |  | Topology reference/override (single-element shorthand for design.topologyConfirmedRefs) |

| `executionMode` | string |  | manual | hybrid | agentic |
| `correlationId` | string |  | Consumer correlation id (echoed) |

#### REST
Endpoint: `POST /api/v1/evaluate`

| Field | Req. | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kinds` |  | Evaluation kinds requested |
| `workspaceRef` |  | Opaque workspace reference (ADR-0074). Resolved server-side; never a raw path. |
| `tenant` |  | Opaque tenant context |
| `product` |  | Opaque product context |
| `initiative` |  | Opaque initiative context |
| `phaseId` |  | Canonical SDLC phase id |
| `gateId` |  | Gate id to evaluate |
| `rulesetRef` |  | Versioned ruleset reference |
| `topologyRef` |  | Topology reference/override |
| `executionMode` |  | Execution mode |
| `correlationId` |  | Consumer correlation id (echoed, never interpreted) |
| `initiativeGroup` |  | Opaque initiative-group context |
| `artifacts` |  | Declared artifact facts (not scanned from disk) |
| `evidence` |  | Declared evidence facts |
| `requester` |  | WHO asked for the evaluation (actor type/id, model, session). Attribution of the REQUEST, never of a finding. |
| `repositoryRevision` |  | WHICH revision was judged (revision, repositoryRef, branch, committedAt, dirty). Absent means the producer did not know it. |
| `qualitySignals` |  | Canonical quality-signal evidence (ADR-0111). Evaluated inline; the Core never executes a provider. |
| `repoFacts` |  | Canonical structural fact base (GT-589), produced OUTSIDE the Core and passed inline. Absent yields no structural findings, never a failure. |
| `baselineRepoFacts` |  | The SAME repository at an earlier revision (GT-594), for the signals that only exist between two points in time. |
| `checkpoint` |  | Declared checkpoint context |
| `deployment` |  | Declared deployment context |
| `architecture` |  | Declared architecture context |
| `design` |  | Declared design context (ADR-0104). design.topologyConfirmedRefs: string[] is the confirmed topology composition (GT-688). |
| `externalReferences` |  | External reference facts |
| `sdlcConfig` |  | Tenant SDLC configuration (Core resolves nothing) |
| `customConstraints` |  | Tenant custom constraints |
| `rulesetVersion` |  | Versioned ruleset pointer |
| `policyRefs` |  | Versioned policy references |
| `maxSkippedFraction` |  | Coverage floor: fail when the fraction of applicable rules that did NOT run exceeds this value. |
| `blueprintRef` |  | Blueprint reference |
| `schemaRef` |  | Schema reference |
| `decisionHistory` |  | Decision history references |
| `expectedResult` |  | Expected verdict (advisory self-check) |
| `passthrough` |  | Opaque passthrough facts (echoed; the Core evaluates declared facts, never disk) |
| `schemaVersion` |  | Contract schema version the consumer is sending |
| `evaluationInput` |  | Inline satellite content evaluated in memory. When present, the Core evaluates these files (no disk read/write, no network for the content) instead of resolving a workspaceRef/satellitePath. |
| `satellitePath` |  | LEGACY (deprecated): filesystem path to the satellite repository. Use workspaceRef instead. Path traversal validation required before use. |
| `corePath` |  | LEGACY: explicit path to the Evolith Core repository |
| `topology` |  | LEGACY: topology override |
| `phase` |  | LEGACY: SDLC phase (f1..f5) |

Example:
```http
POST /api/v1/evaluate
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "kinds": [
    "gate",
    "compliance"
  ],
  "workspaceRef": "your-satellite"
}
```

### Phase gate evaluation

> `gate-evaluate` — Evaluate a specific SDLC phase gate (discovery/design/construction/qa/release) and emit GateEvidence

#### CLI
Command: `evolith-cli gate evaluate`

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-p, --phase <phase>` | SDLC phase: discovery, design, construction, qa, release |
| `-s, --satellite [path]` | Satellite project path (default: nearest-ancestor evolith.yaml from cwd) |
| `--project [path]` | [deprecated] Alias for --satellite (ADR-0109) |
| `-c, --core [path]` | Evolith Core path (default: auto-detect) |
| `-f, --format [string]` | Output format: json (ADR-0073 envelope) or human (default) |
| `--evaluated-by [actor]` | Actor class: human (default), agent, ci |
| `--initiative [id]` | Opaque initiative context, echoed in meta.context |
| `--tenant [id]` | Opaque tenant context, echoed in meta.context |
| `--webhook-url <url>` | URL to POST the gate evidence upon completion |

Example:
```bash
evolith-cli gate evaluate --phase discovery --project /abs/path/to/your-satellite --core /abs/path/to/evolith-core --evaluated-by ci --format json
```

### Measure downstream-phase artifact completeness

> `phase-artifacts-evaluate` — Measure downstream-phase artifact completeness for a topology composition (advisory, non-binding; ADR-0104 / DN-06 / GT-434)

#### CLI
Command: `evolith-cli topology phase-artifacts`

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-c, --core <path>` | Path to the Evolith core repository (default: profile.core or cwd) |
| `-p, --phase <phase>` | Downstream SDLC phase: construction | quality | deployment |
| `-t, --topologies <list>` | Confirmed topology composition (comma-separated ids), e.g. microservices,event-driven |
| `-d, --declared <list>` | Artifact kinds declared as present (comma-separated), e.g. test-summary-report,coverage-report |
| `-f, --format <string>` | Output format: json (ADR-0073 envelope) or human (default) |

```bash
evolith-cli topology phase-artifacts --phase construction --topologies modular-monolith --core /abs/path/to/evolith-core --format json
```

#### REST
Endpoint: `POST /api/v1/architecture/evaluate-phase-artifacts`

| Field | Req. | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `phase` | ✓ | Downstream SDLC phase (ADR-0104 / DN-06) |
| `topologies` | ✓ | Confirmed topology composition |
| `declaredArtifacts` |  | Artifact kinds the consumer declares as present |

Example:
```http
POST /api/v1/architecture/evaluate-phase-artifacts
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "phase": "construction",
  "topologies": [
    "modular-monolith"
  ]
}
```
